title: agent-dns/1 parsed record
description: The object produced by parsing one TXT record at _agent.<domain>. This schema covers shape only: the same-domain rule (url host is <domain> or a subdomain of it) depends on the domain the record was found under and is checked by validateRecord, not here.

v.description: The contract version token. Must be the first pair of the record.

url.description: The https URL of the domain's agent/1 discovery document. No credentials. Must be on <domain> or a subdomain of it.

org.description: Optional. The organisation the document belongs to, as org/<slug>.

^x-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$.description: Private extension keys. A resolver carries them through and never acts on them.
